name: Seestar S50
notes: Seeded rig. 250mm focal length and 2.9um pixels give roughly 2.4 arcsec/px over a 1.29 x 0.73 degree field. Internal changer holds UV/IR-cut duo-band and an opaque dark position.

name: Seestar S30
notes: Seeded rig. 150mm focal length and 2.9um pixels give roughly 4.0 arcsec/px over a 2.46 degree diagonal field.

name: Seestar S30 Pro
description: ZWO Seestar S30 Pro smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. 160mm focal length and 2.9um pixels give roughly 3.7 arcsec/px over a 4.6 degree diagonal field. Same aperture as the S30 but four times the sensor area.

name: DWARF mini
notes: Seeded rig. Roughly 4 arcsec/px over a 2.46 x 1.2 degree field. Writes no IMAGETYP to its FITS headers — ingest classifies its frames from on-sky header evidence and the filename instead.

name: DWARF II
notes: Seeded rig. 1.45um pixels at 100mm give roughly 3.0 arcsec/px. No internal filter changer — DWARF II filters are external 1.25 inch accessories fitted with an adapter.

name: Seestar S50 Pro
description: ZWO Seestar S50 Pro smart telescope
notes: Seeded rig. 260mm and 2.9um pixels give roughly 2.3 arcsec/px over a 2.8 degree diagonal field. Same 3-position changer as the rest of the Seestar line. Its imager is an OmniVision OS08B10 rather than a Sony.

name: Celestron Origin
notes: Seeded rig for the original #12099 with the IMX178 camera. f/2.2 RASA at 335mm gives roughly 1.48 arcsec/px. No filter wheel: the Origin has a drawer taking 1.25 or 2 inch filters the user supplies.

name: Celestron Origin Mark II
description: Celestron Origin Mark II smart observatory
notes: Seeded rig for the Mark II with the IMX678 camera; same RASA optics as the original. 2.0um pixels give roughly 1.23 arcsec/px over a 1.32 x 0.75 degree field.

name: Unistellar eVscope 2
notes: Seeded rig. 450mm and 2.9um pixels give roughly 1.33 arcsec/px over 45.6 x 34.2 arcmin. No filters: Unistellar's light-pollution reduction is processing rather than glass; the solar filter is an accessory.

name: Unistellar eQuinox 2
notes: Seeded rig. Optically identical to the eVscope 2; the difference is the eyepiece; which does not affect imaging.

name: Unistellar Odyssey
notes: Seeded rig. 320mm and 1.45um pixels give roughly 0.93 arcsec/px over 45 x 33.6 arcmin.

name: Unistellar Odyssey Pro
notes: Seeded rig. Same optics and imager as the Odyssey plus an eyepiece.
